en.headline: LCSD sets up Asian Games focal sites across 18 districts
en.dek: Sports centres will broadcast live coverage from 19 September to 4 October so the public can watch and cheer for national and Hong Kong athletes.
body: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department will open Asian Games Focal Sites at designated sports centres in all 18 districts to broadcast live coverage of the 20th Asian Games, which run from 19 September to 4 October in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan.

The sites open on 19 September from 5pm to 8pm and thereafter daily from 8am to 9pm until 4 October. Members of the public are welcome to watch the competitions and support athletes of the country and Hong Kong, China. Venue details and any changes will be posted on the dedicated LCSD webpage.

On opening day the department will hold a launching ceremony and Sports Fun For All sports day at 2pm at Hong Kong Park Sports Centre. The event will feature volleyball, football and basketball skill demonstrations and sharing by athletes including Sun Yue, Sze Hang-yu and Lee Ho-ching. Further sports days focusing on the three major ball games will continue at six centres through December.

zh.headline: 康文署18區設亞運觀賞站 鼓勵市民為運動員打氣
zh.dek: 指定體育館將於9月19日至10月4日直播亞運會賽事，公眾可到場觀看並為國家及香港運動員加油。
body: 康樂及文化事務署將於全港18區指定體育館設立「亞運觀賞站」，直播9月19日至10月4日在日本愛知・名古屋舉行的第20屆亞洲運動會賽事，供市民觀看並為國家及香港中國運動員打氣。
觀賞站於9月19日下午5時至8時開放，其後每日上午8時至晚上9時，直至10月4日。詳細地點及如有調整，會在康文署專題網頁公布。
開幕當日下午2時，康文署將於香港公園體育館舉行「全民運動日暨亞運觀賞站啟動禮」，當日以排球為重點，並有足球及籃球示範，以及孫玥、施幸余及李皓晴等運動員分享。其後至12月會在六個體育館繼續舉辦以三大球為主題的全民運動日。
